title: Driven app runs end the sessions they start

requirements.text: A driven run's {"quit":true} ends every session that run started, so no genlock-host or claude is left behind
requirements.check: manual: drive the built app with a session open and quit; pgrep finds no host for that run's socket afterwards

requirements.text: {"quit":"keep"} still leaves sessions running, for tests of surviving a relaunch
A driven run with no GENLOCK_APP_VOICE_BASE keeps its session sockets beside its drive script, never in the real app's voice folder
requirements.check: manual: driven run without VOICE_BASE; its host.sock is under the script's folder

requirements.text: The leftover test hosts still running are ended
requirements.check: manual: ps shows no genlock-host whose folder is under /private/tmp/claude-501

evidence: drive.json (open demo, quit:true): during run pgrep showed host 34121/34123 + claude; 2s after quit pgrep -f 'genlock-host run $S' empty, no claude
keep.json (quit:"keep"): host 35365 still alive 4s after app exit; then ended with genlock-host kill
run without GENLOCK_APP_VOICE_BASE: host.sock at scratchpad/drv/voice/DF6A2081.../host.sock, beside drive.json
genlock-host kill on 5 tabrow sockets (Nov 10, session 8cca1b06): ps count of genlock-host under claude-501 -> 0, their claude --session-id processes -> 0

what: A driven run killed before its quit step (crash, alarm, agent timeout) still leaves its sessions running: nothing ends them but quit
verify: pgrep -fl 'genlock-host run /private/tmp' after any driven run that did not reach quit

answers.observed: pgrep counts before/after each driven quit, and ps after the kill
answers.cause: measured: both batches' drive scripts end in {quit:true}, which only remembered sessions; hosts are built to outlive the app
answers.absence: pgrep searched by the run's folder; a host started elsewhere would not show, but the socket listing showed only this run's
answers.assumption: no test relies on plain quit keeping sessions; those tests must now say keep
answers.falsify: a driven run reaching quit:true that leaves a host behind
